bind_addr.description: IP address the server will listen on. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

threads.description: Number of worker threads. Set to 0 to auto-detect based on CPU count.

loglevel.description: Verbosity of logging: 0 (quiet) to 4 (debug). Higher values log more.

pidfile.description: Path to file where the process ID (PID) will be written. Leave empty ('') to disable.

udp_enabled.description: Enable UDP relay support (requires microsocks built with -DENABLE_UDP).

authmode.description: Authentication mode: none (no auth), userpass (username:password), or combined.

users.description: List of allowed user credentials. Only used when authmode includes userpass.

password.description: Password for authentication. Store securely (e.g., via secret manager).

user_rules.description: List of destination access rules per user. If empty, all destinations allowed.

destinations.description: List of allowed destination hosts or host:port combinations (e.g., ['example.com', '10.0.0.0/8:443']).

chroot.description: Directory to chroot into after startup. Leave empty ('') to disable chrooting.

user_after_bind.description: System user to drop privileges to after binding privileged ports.
